{{Quote|We lost Matchstick and Tag.|[[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], during the Battle of the Kaliida Nebula|<ref name="Shadow of Malevolence">{{TCW|Shadow of Malevolence|Shadow of ''Malevolence''}}</ref>}}
'''Tag''' was a [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone trooper pilot]] in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy's]] [[Shadow Squadron/Legends|Shadow Squadron]].

==Biography==
Tag flew in [[Shadow Squadron/Legends|Shadow Squadron]] as Shadow Five and was [[Death/Legends|killed]] in action during the [[Battle of the Kaliida Nebula/Legends|Battle of the Kaliida Nebula]] when the [[Engine/Legends|engines]] of fellow [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Matchstick/Legends|Matchstick's]] damaged [[BTL-B Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wing bomber]] failed and caused the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] to crash into Tag's. Tag's [[Gunner/Legends|gunner]] immediately died with him.
